user_message: Attempt 2 fixes the sole attempt-1 failure (R-COH-OTHER-INTERNAL-CONTRADICTION). Verified independently, not trusted from the dispatch summary: (1) git diff confirms only plugins/relay/resources/component-map-template.md changed since attempt 1 — the other three files are byte-identical (same blob hashes). (2) The template's enrichment_truncated marker-line gloss and field-reference bullet were rewritten from a universally-quantified 'false only when enrichment is genuinely complete for every pre-matched candidate' (vacuously true over an empty candidate set) to an explicit disjunction: true whenever any candidate lacks metadata OR the candidate set is empty; false only for a non-empty, genuinely-complete set. This is the correct negation of the prior predicate and closes the vacuous-truth escape with no residual edge case (verified the size-1 case resolves correctly under either branch). It now matches Task 3's guard (b) in relay-design-map.md near-verbatim and satisfies PRD AC-10's 'given an empty component-set list, enrichment_truncated is not reported as complete' clause. (3) The implementer's two 'no edit needed' claims both verified correct: inventory_truncated's bullet is a single direct signal about whether the library search itself was truncated, not a claim quantified over the candidate set, so it never had the vacuous-truth trap; rung's bullet only reads enrichment_truncated's boolean, so fixing that boolean's derivation automatically makes an empty-candidate-set run report DEGRADED_NO_ENRICHMENT instead of FULL, with no direct edit needed to the rung bullet itself. (4) R-DM7 in design-map-reviewer.md (unchanged) still matches the template's reworded completeness semantics — its 'declares enrichment_truncated: false while the evidence bundle shows incomplete metadata coverage' failure condition is now backed by a template definition that no longer permits a false-negative on an empty candidate set. (5) Re-ran Levels 1/2/3 myself (not the implementer's stale attempt-1-memory report, which incorrectly claimed 2 pre-existing Level 2 FAILs) and npm run validate: all PASS, 12/12. (6) Re-dispatched the code-reviewer-semantic sub-agent for a fresh K=5 pass scoped to this attempt's delta plus the three unchanged files' relevant excerpts for cross-checking: zero findings, R-COH-TASK-CONTRADICTION passed. Full rubric pass — 8/8 core items plus 5/5 R-COH-* rows (R-COH-DS-REUSE zero-emitted, no figma_track/design_source:figma gate active).
